name: European Commission AI-assisted cyberattack (Oct-Nov 2026)
description: Red = confirmed by the Commission; orange = reported or assessed highly likely (CERT-EU, Politico); yellow = hypotheses based on ARTEX techniques in other campaigns (FBI FLASH, 13 Nov 2026), not confirmed for the Commission. ATT&CK Enterprise v20.1.

techniques.comment: Confirmed: Commission says the campaign was AI-generated, using a publicly available AI tool.
Highly likely: ARTEX, an open-source AI penetration-testing framework (CERT-EU, Politico).
Reported: ARTEX used to scan Commission systems for weaknesses (Politico sources).
Hypothesis: ARTEX campaigns exploit internet-facing apps such as employee portals (FBI).
Hypothesis: abuse of cloud/app identities, as in the ConnectWise/M365 ARTEX campaign (FBI).
Hypothesis: password spraying seen in ARTEX campaigns (FBI).
Hypothesis: web shells deployed by ARTEX agents in other campaigns (FBI).
Hypothesis: ARTEX automates privilege escalation; under 3 hours to privileged access in some cases (FBI).
Open question: whether HR data in Sysper (names, grades, addresses) was accessed.
Open question: no confirmed data theft; Commission says no evidence of a breach affecting staff as a whole.
